title: Associate Cloud Support Engineer
description:
About the Company:

 nClouds is a credentialed, award-winning provider of DevOps and professional cloud services, products, and
solutions specializing in modern infrastructures on AWS. We work as an extension of our clients and love
tackling their stickiest challenges. All so our clients can deliver innovation faster and create awesome
customer experiences.

General Details:
Job Title Associate Cloud Support Engineer Department MSP
Reporting To Senior Cloud Support
Engineer/Team Lead
Subordinates N/A

Job Summary:
Associate Cloud Support Engineer is a junior-level position in nClouds Oncall Support
Services team. The Associate Cloud Support Engineer is directly responsible for
handling alerts and tickets for the assigned clients and works under the supervision of
the Senior Support Engineer.

Key Responsibilities:
● Associates often work under the supervision of more experienced support
engineers or AWS professionals.
● The first level of response to client’s infrastructure issues, alerts, tickets, and
queries.
● Ensure in-time response to clients' alerts, tickets, and queries within the
agreed-upon SLA.
● Ensure the alert management system (PagerDuty) is handled during his/her shift.
● Assisted the Senior Support Engineer in building and maintaining the Runbooks of
the assigned clients.
● Assisted the Senior Support Engineer in configuring and maintaining monitoring
and alerting platforms for the assigned client's infrastructure.
1
Associate Cloud Support Engineer
● Complete assigned training and certifications.
● Actively participate in Demos and write blog posts. They may also assist with
documentation and knowledge base articles.
● Responsibilities often include providing technical assistance to AWS customers via
email or chat, helping them resolve fundamental technical issues, and answering
general questions about AWS services.
Relationships
Internal Relations External Relations
● Trainee Support Engineer, Senior Support
Engineer, Team Lead
● nClouds Support Services Clients

Required Qualifications: 
● Good understanding of basic cloud concepts.
● Basic to intermediate-level skills in Linux/Unix-based OS.
● Basic to Intermediate level knowledge and some hands-on experience with AWS
services like VPC, EC2, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, IAM, RDS, ECS/EKS, Lambda,
Opsworks, VPN, etc.
● Basic to Intermediate level knowledge of Shell/Bash scripting.
● Hands-on experience and basic knowledge of Monitoring tools like Nagios, Icinga,
Datadog, NewRelic, Cloudwatch, etc.
● Hands-on experience and basic knowledge of logging tools, such as AWS
Cloudwatch logs, Papertrail, Datadog Logs, and Sumologic.
● Basic experience using Alert Management Systems like PagerDuty, Opsgenie
VictorOps, etc.
● Understanding of concepts like DevOps and SRE.
● Ability to rotate in 24/7 shifts, including weekends.
● Ability and hunger to learn new technologies quickly.
● Excellent written/verbal English language communication skills.

Work Nature:
Work Location Remote Business Travel No
Work Schedule 24/7 shift rotation Flexitime Yes, it includes rotating shifts,
including weekends
